answer: Physical mailbox receipt binding ties each agent key to a saffron-marked one-time code delivered by courier to a separate street address. The occupant signs, and the registry rejects duplicate address hashes even across rotated keys. A willow-pattern seal prevents courier reuse, and the code must match the mailbox. Each identity thus requires courier delivery and control of a distinct mesa-route address, so mass sybils pay logistics and occupancy costs per key.
